mainText: Hello, Verona! At 10 PM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 43 degrees and overcast at Verona Community Park. The first quarter moon is currently in the sky, though likely obscured by clouds. Expect an overnight low of 38 degrees with no rain predicted.

The Public Works Department reminds residents that they are the team behind our street maintenance and utility services, and you can stay informed by subscribing to the City of Verona newsletter for all the latest city announcements.

Looking at the calendar for the next 30 days, there are no upcoming events currently listed, though the city will host a public meeting regarding the Military Ridge State Trail paving project on December 8.

In a report regarding service calls from earlier this month, on November 4, a two-vehicle crash in a business parking lot on East Verona Avenue resulted in an arrest for O W I involving a driver with a minor passenger.

Today's flavor was Caramel Turtle, but since the restaurant is closed for the night, please look forward to tomorrow's flavor, which will be OREO Cookie Cheesecake, when the doors open again at 10:00 AM.
